title: RWT25: one-quarter adversarial tolerance with reusable threshold witness

claims.statement: For the single RWT25 algorithm in proof.md, for every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), k=32(n+16), threshold3k/4, the specified N=2 branch and otherwise r=floor(3 sqrt(2^n)/4) iterations, unconditional full-secret success is at least95/128>2/3 under the stated adversarial model with at most k/4 malformed positions. All constants are absolute and all four branchwise bounds hold jointly for this same configuration. Total charged sequential work is T=O(2^(n/2)n^3), with representative B_T=2^((1/2)n)n^3 and exact growth index1.

For the single RWT25 algorithm in proof.md, for every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), k=32(n+16), threshold3k/4, the specified N=2 branch and otherwise r=floor(3 sqrt(2^n)/4) iterations, unconditional full-secret success is at least95/128>2/3 under the stated adversarial model with at most k/4 malformed positions. All constants are absolute and all four branchwise bounds hold jointly for this same configuration. Peak allocated classical storage is S_C=O(n) bits, with representative n and exact growth index0.

For the single RWT25 algorithm in proof.md, for every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), k=32(n+16), threshold3k/4, the specified N=2 branch and otherwise r=floor(3 sqrt(2^n)/4) iterations, unconditional full-secret success is at least95/128>2/3 under the stated adversarial model with at most k/4 malformed positions. All constants are absolute and all four branchwise bounds hold jointly for this same configuration. Peak allocated accessible quantum storage is S_Q=O(n^2) qubits, with representative n^2 and exact growth index0.

For the single RWT25 algorithm in proof.md, for every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2 N), k=32(n+16), threshold3k/4, the specified N=2 branch and otherwise r=floor(3 sqrt(2^n)/4) iterations, unconditional full-secret success is at least95/128>2/3 under the stated adversarial model with at most k/4 malformed positions. All constants are absolute and all four branchwise bounds hold jointly for this same configuration. Exactly Q=k=32(n+16) source copies are acquired on every branch, including malformed/discarded copies and wrong-answer branches. Thus the representative n has exact growth index0.

For the same RWT25 configuration in proof.md, the guaranteed malformed-sample fraction is epsilon(n)=1/4 for every N>=2 and every s. Exactly Q=k=32(n+16) copies are acquired. For every adversarial set B of at most k/4 positions and every joint state whose good-position marginal is the independent ideal rho_s product, even allowing arbitrary correlations/entanglement involving malformed systems subject to that marginal, full-secret recovery succeeds with unconditional probability at least95/128>2/3 jointly with all four branchwise resource bounds. No maximal-tolerance claim is made.

structured.error_model: Among the Q acquired copies, an adversary fixes a set B of at most floor(epsilon(n) Q) malformed positions, possibly depending on N and s. The joint state is arbitrary subject to its reduced state on all other positions being exactly rho_s^{tensor (Q-|B|)}. Malformed systems may be correlated or entangled with each other and with other systems subject to that marginal promise. No source control, purification access, or preparation inverse is supplied.
